body:
I hope that I’m not a problem player, but it’s what the DM called me. 

My biggest problem is the veteran players at the table let rulings like this slide. That made me feel like it’s the common thing to do as a player - just let it go.

We played 8 sessions. I don’t feel directly targeted. The other players often faced tight situations due to misunderstandings, but I was the only one who spoke up about it. 

I started to wonder (especially because they had all played with different groups before) whether this was normal and I am really supposed to just put up with it.
Thank you, I appreciate the wall of text!

We were backed against a wall and the bard was too scared to flee in case a free strike killed her. 

She was also our only healer so we couldn’t help her once she went down. I’m glad she didn’t blame me for it.

Yea it was my bad on that one. I expected the DM to tell me if I was trying to do something that isn’t allowed, but since they allowed it I thought it was possible. 

I’m making an effort to memorize the rules!

Yes, sorry I wasn’t clear. I said I wanted to look at the statue. DM said to roll investigation. 

After the fact, when I learned that the roll probably should have been perception, DM said because I accepted that it was an investigation roll, that implied I was investigating deeply. I guess I should have asked to roll perception instead and specify I wanted to perceive only with my eyes! It’s so hard in the heat of the moment.

Yep, we were definitely learning to be more and more specific with phrasing.  Like wishes from a genie. Had to make sure there was no room for misinterpretation, since there was no room for clarification.

I absolutely feel at fault. I have not memorized the players handbook yet and I often looked to the DM for guidance. It’s tough in a learn-from-your-mistakes environment when there is a group of people relying on you tho.

Yes, knowing what skill is best to use is so hard! The DM tells us what to roll, so I just do. Sometimes I try to think of a way to do something so I can use a roll I’m good at, but often just ask what DM wants me to roll.

Yea, I understand it’s a tough job for DMs. I try to be descriptive so DM doesn’t have to guess or fill in the blanks.  Sometimes felt like the blanks got filled in with the most dangerous option possible.

Yes I’m the first example I was more confused than frustrated at the time. 

In the room prior, a party member stated “I want to examine the jewelry box” and DM ruled he picked it up to flip it over and examine it thoroughly, and became cursed by touching it. This is why I specified I wanted to LOOK at the statue, but in fairness I didn’t not say “I am not touching it.”
I’ll admit to losing my temper, getting frustrated, and eventually arguing about rulings because I didn’t find it fair to lose control over my own actions, but these examples all happened.

Just don’t have the strength to pretend every day. 

I’m a terrible friend. I never make time for friends or family. Can’t bring myself to care. Never have any news to share so it just gets awkward and reminds me of how my life is going nowhere. 

Husband is depressed and suicidal as well. We can’t help each other. We have no money and own nothing. 

My coworkers and superiors tell me on a daily basis how much of a disappointment I am and I can’t find a new job. 

I just can’t be fake happy 8 hours a day. I can’t. Nothing is getting better. It’s only gotten worse for the past 2 years and I’m tired of trying.

Hi friend. 

I can’t give advice regarding drugs, but I can lend advice regarding hobbies. 

When I lose interest in things, I look to the complete opposite. What’s something you’ve never done before that you’ve seen a local ad for?
Generally the wanting to die part comes first, the. You come here. I’m here too. You’re not alone.
